title: Late Charges and Waivers under the Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contract
content:
These are the late-charge terms of Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts.

## When a late fee may be charged

(a) A late fee is assessed once on an installment that is still unpaid after the grace period.

(b) A late fee may be assessed only after the grace period counted from the installment's due date has passed. Grace is counted in calendar days with the due date as day 0; a late fee may be assessed from the day after the last grace day if the installment is still unpaid. The due date is the one on the contract record for the installment concerned.

(c) Each installment bears at most one late fee: a late-fee entry already naming that installment on the same contract means no second one is charged.

## Amount

(d) The late fee is the tier's late fee percentage of the monthly payment, no less than the tier's minimum and no more than its maximum, rounded to the cent — **this clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the late-fee amount.

## Waivers

(e) A late fee may be waived as goodwill only while the goodwill waivers counted over the rolling 12 months are below the tier's late fee waivers per 12 months — **this clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for goodwill relief.

(f) A late fee assessed in error — the installment was in fact paid within grace, or the due date had been moved — is waived without using a goodwill waiver.

(g) Returned-payment, agent-assisted and deferral fees are never waived as goodwill.

(h) A fee is cleared only on a contract whose status is active or unwound.

## Grace boundary (hypothetical dates, 10 grace days)

| Installment due date (day 0) | Last grace day (day 10) | Date of assessment | May a late fee be assessed if still unpaid? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-05 | 2026-05-15 | 2026-05-15 | no, still within grace |
| 2026-05-05 | 2026-05-15 | 2026-05-16 | yes, the day after the last grace day |
| 2026-05-05 | 2026-05-15 | 2026-05-20 | yes |

## Points of judgement

- An installment paid on day 8 of grace carries no late fee; if one was charged, it was charged in error and is waived without using a goodwill waiver.
- A contract whose status is paid off does not have fees cleared; a contract that is active or unwound does.
- A deferral fee or a returned-payment fee is not a candidate for goodwill waiver.
